title: てんとう虫が離れても

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower and I are on the way back to campus after going out. Suddenly…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On Rice Shower's outstretched finger rests a very small ladybug.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ladybugs are a sign of good luck. Did you know that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: This is the first time one's ever landed on me… Maybe something good is going to happen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A bit later, Rice Shower stops at a vending machine to buy juice, when…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no way! I won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower blinks in surprise as the word “Winner” flickers vibrantly on the vending machine's display.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! I've never won anything from a vending machine before in my life.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower hangs her head as if she's uneasy for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …I'm a little scared.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If I have good luck now… that probably means… I'm going to bring bad luck to everyone else later…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because… that's what always happens.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But I think… what worries me the most…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is the fact that I always end up having these thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Even though something good happened to me… and I'm here with you… I still think this way.
choice_data_list: Well, you'll just have to create enough happiness to offset that misfortune.
We can turn misfortune into memories too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Even though something good happened to me… and I'm here with you… I still think this way.
choice_data_list: Well, you'll just have to create enough happiness to offset that misfortune.
We can turn misfortune into memories too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: …You're right. That is my goal, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But I can't help but wonder… can I really do it? Is it pointless to even try?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I might not be able to do it on my own, but maybe I can do it with you…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I might not be able to do it on my own, but maybe I can do it with you…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Or at least, I will someday!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It looks like Rice Shower's feeling more optimistic, even if just a little.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Turn misfortune… into memories?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I've never thought of it that way before. Can you really do that?
choice_data_list: I'll turn any bad luck into a memory of being with you.
I'll turn any bad luck into a memory of being with you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: As long as you're with me, I'll try to do the same…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: As long as you're with me, I'll try to do the same…

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No… I will do the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower's expression lightens a little.
